alt: London in 1647 across the bottom of the page, Old St Paul's among the roofs and beside it a tower crane lifting a bundle of steel (after Wenceslaus Hollar, Long View of London from Bankside, 1647)

Amsterdam from the water in 1611 across the bottom of the page, ships at anchor, and among them a speedboat towing a parasail high over the city (after Claes Jansz. Visscher, Profile of Amsterdam from the IJ, 1611)

Utrecht from the fields in 1648 across the bottom of the page, the Dom tower over the town, spires and windmills, cows on the pasture; across the pasture runs a modern railway under its overhead wires, and now and then a high-speed train passes, one way and then the other (after Herman Saftleven, Utrecht from the east, 1648)
